name: APTDC Haritha Resort Restaurant, Lambasingi
signature_dish: Hot Andhra meals in the cold of the 'Kashmir of Andhra Pradesh'
why_it_matters: Lambasingi is a tiny Chintapalli-mandal hill village with almost no commercial dining, so the restaurant at AP Tourism's Haritha Resort is the most dependable proper meal in the area. For visitors at the government resort — or anyone wanting a hot plate after a cold dawn frost-watch — it is the safe sit-down option.
insider_tip: Lambasingi famously freezes near dawn in winter; a hot meal here matters more than the menu. Eating options shut early in the village, so plan dinner around the resort's service hours. Carry snacks and water — the hamlet is barely touristed.
signature_address: APTDC Haritha Resort, Lambasingi, Chintapalli Mandal, Alluri Sitharama Raju District, Andhra Pradesh 531111

name: SS Farm House Resort Restaurant
signature_dish: All-day multi-cuisine dining at a forest-edge farm resort
why_it_matters: SS Farm House sits in Rajupalkala Village just outside Lambasingi, ringed by forest, and runs a multi-cuisine all-day dining restaurant — one of the few private dining anchors in an area that has very little commercial food infrastructure. It is the alternative to the government Haritha resort for a sit-down meal.
insider_tip: Call ahead — it is a small farm resort and meals are timed around residents. The forest setting is the draw; come for a relaxed lunch rather than a quick stop.
signature_address: SS Farm House, Rajupalkala Village, Lambasingi, Chintapalli Mandal, Alluri Sitharama Raju District, Andhra Pradesh 531111

name: Lambasingi Silver Oaks Resorts & Restaurant
signature_dish: Resort-restaurant meals near the Lambasingi frost zone
why_it_matters: A resort-restaurant at Pedabarada near Lambasingi — listed on TripAdvisor with its own property page, it adds one more verified sit-down dining option to a village that otherwise relies on the government resort. Useful for travellers staying on the Pedabarada side of the frost zone.
insider_tip: Phone ahead in winter peak — Lambasingi accommodation fills for the frost season and restaurant service follows occupancy. A practical lunch stop on the Lambasingi loop.
signature_address: Lambasingi Silver Oaks Resorts & Restaurant, Pedabarada, Chintapalli Mandal, Alluri Sitharama Raju District, Andhra Pradesh 531111

name: Lambasingi Bamboo Chicken & Roadside Stalls
signature_dish: Bamboo chicken and hot idli from village roadside cooks
why_it_matters: Lambasingi has barely any restaurants, so its real street eating is the village's roadside cooks — women grilling bamboo chicken over open fires and vendors serving steaming idli, the same tribal-belt food found across Araku and Chintapalli. In winter the village also turns into a fresh-strawberry market.
insider_tip: Buy strawberries, dragon fruit and farm coffee direct from village vendors in season — prices are low and the produce is local. Carry your own water; quality sit-down food is scarce once the resorts' kitchens close.
signature_address: Lambasingi village and Lambasingi–Chintapalli road, Chintapalli Mandal, Alluri Sitharama Raju District, Andhra Pradesh 531111
